title: Exported Mac App store pkg missing required sandbox entitlement when uploading via Transporter
body: ### Tested versions 4.7.2 ### System information macOS 26.6.2 ### Issue description It appears that something has broken in the codesigning/packaging export process for Mac App store exports. When trying to upload a .pgk package exported from Godot via Transporter I get the following error: Indicating it seems the `com.apple.security.app-sandbox` entitlement hasn't been appropriately applied in code signing step of the export process, even if the App Sandbox entitlement is enabled in the export settings. Before Godot started supporting doing all this nice app store packaging (embedding provisioning profile, setting code signing and creating the installer .pkg package) for you I remember doing this myself, starting with an unsigned .app exported from Godot, adding the embedded provisioning profile and then applying the entitlements (including com.apple.security.app-sandbox) via `codesign`: `codesign --timestamp --options runtime --entitlements -s "" -f -v ` and then creating a signed package with `productbuild` `productbuild --component /Applications --sign "" ` I've now tried to reproduce this process that I'm pretty sure worked before, but I get the same error in Transporter trying to upload the resulting pkg. So it might be that the standard for how these entitlements should be applied have changed since I last did this (2023) and the same changes have also broken the export Mac App Store package generation in Godot. I've not been able to figure out what the issue is, but I found this thread https://developer.apple.com/forums/thread/41400 on the developer forums that seems to be about the same issue, where seemingly correctly signed sandboxed apps are now rejected with this error and might provide some hints. ### Steps to reproduce - Have a Godot project - Export for macOS , Distribution type App Store (Requires you have app store distribution certificates/identifiers, profiles etc) - Once you have your output .pkg use the Transporter app to upload this to the Apple App Store (or just use the Verify function, that does the verification without uploading it) - Observe getting the error shown above about missing `com.apple.security.app-sandbox` entitlement ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Not project specific
